retrievalProfile.description: A 1960s-style music album layout featuring a central group portrait of a band in matching suits surrounded by bold, multi-colored sans-serif display type on a clean white background.

recipe.visualDefinition: A clean, high-contrast composition featuring a group of musicians in shimmering blue tuxedos posed with instruments, anchored by a white background and framed by heavy, colorful sans-serif text in red, green, and blue.
coreVisualRelationships: Bold primary-colored text framing a central photographic subject
Matching formal attire creating visual unity among the band members
High-key white background providing maximum contrast for typography
Diagonal arrangement of instruments leading the eye through the group

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central group portrait occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame, scaled to allow significant typographic margins.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large red title at the top and the seated band members in the center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down reading order from the red title, through the band names, down to the group portrait, and finally to the tracklist on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white space around the perimeter and between text blocks to maintain clarity.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm Red (primary title and band name)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Emerald Green and Sky Blue (secondary text and tracklist)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation for text against a neutral, slightly aged white background.

letterConstructionRules: Tight letter spacing for display text
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Mixing extended and condensed widths of the same sans-serif family to create rhythmic variety.
graphicDevices: Small logo icon in bottom corner

preserve: Primary color coding for different text blocks
Heavy weight of the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the mid-century industrial sans-serif feel.
Matches the condensed, heavy weight of the secondary titles.
Matches the wide, flat-terminal look of the main title.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photograph of a 6-man band in matching shimmering light-blue 1960s tuxedos with black bowties, holding a saxophone, bass guitar, and drumsticks, posed in front of a clean white studio background with a piano on the right.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply bold, uppercase sans-serif text. The main title in red at the top, a secondary title in green on the left, and a tracklist in blue on the right.

verificationChecks: Are the band members in matching formal attire?
Is the typography bold and sans-serif?
Are the colors red, green, and blue used for text?

mustAchieve: Balanced distribution of text and image
avoid: Modern font choices like Helvetica Neue Light

postGenerationChecks: Text is legible and correctly colored
Band posing looks natural for a 60s promo shot
No modern elements (cellphones, modern instruments) are present
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a central group portrait in formal wear with a high-contrast white background and frame it with bold, multi-colored, uppercase sans-serif typography.
